decisions.reason: The source changes the creative adaptation strategy, but it does not explicitly replace the established product keywords, claims, benefit sources, or script-message rules; the last reference was already the primary script reference.
Recreating the last reference does not alter the existing requirement for a direct, attention-grabbing hook suited to the Indian market.
The reference-based creative change does not revise the conversion objective, CPL target, or priority of conversion performance over aesthetics.
The source selects a direction for the full video after the preview review; it does not change the preview's required duration, language, content, or review sequence.
The source changes which reference concept to follow but does not resolve or modify the production-method conflict concerning actual footage, AI-generated scenes, avatars, or static-image animation.
Requesting a better product-specific version of the reference does not change the commissioned video count, duration, testing stage, or conditional additional-video order.
The source contains no timing, deadline, or delivery-status decision.
